name: Persona
summary: An avatar with the name beside or under it, and up to two more lines (role, status, location). The avatar is hidden from assistive technology because the name is written next to it; its presence, state and activity are read after the name instead. Used in list rows, people pickers, comments and profile cards; a person's own profile can offer an Edit photo menu.
a11y: The name and lines are plain text in reading order; presence, state and activity follow the name as hidden words ("Ana Ruiz, Busy"). The Edit photo menu is a MenuButton (APG menu button). Never a link or button as a whole: put it in a ListItem or a Link for that.

props.name: name
props.description: The person's or entity's name, written beside the avatar.

props.name: nameText
props.description: The name as plain words, when `name` isn't a string (for the initials, colour and accessible name).

props.name: secondary
props.description: One line under the name: a role, a team, an email or a status message. Shown from 32 px.

props.name: tertiary
props.description: A third line (a location, a local time, last seen). Shown from 56 px.

props.name: size
props.description: The avatar's size; the type grows with it. 24 for a single line in tables and chips, 32 or 40 in lists, 56+ in cards and profile headers. Default 40.

props.name: textPosition
props.description: `after` (default) beside the avatar; `below` centred under it, for people grids and profile cards.

props.name: onPhotoChange
props.description: The person may change their own picture: an "Edit photo" menu with Upload a photo and, when there is one, Remove photo.

props.name: loading
props.description: Still loading: the avatar placeholder and text lines of the same shape.
